subject: NovumCloud vendor portal: SSO mapping, SIG scope, and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novumcloud.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: security@novumcloud.com
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake: portal access + SIG/CAIQ scope

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the intro call last week. We're trying to finish vendor intake for Redwood and would like to get your profile into Vendr so our InfoSec team can run the SIG/CAIQ crosswalk. Two quick asks before we start:

1) Can you confirm which identity provider you'll use for SSO to upload evidence? We need SAML metadata or a service account for API uploads.
2) Do you plan to upload a full SIG spreadsheet or a trimmed CAIQ export? Our portal prefers CAIQ v4 but will accept SIG Lite.

If you can send a draft SIG/CAIQ file and an SSO diagram, we can provision a temporary "evidence uploader" role for you.

Goal: get your profile into the portal and schedule a short evidence review on Wed (30 min).

Thanks,
Sam Torres
Security Program Manager
NovumCloud

---
Attachment: vendor_upload_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novumcloud.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: portal access + SIG/CAIQ scope

Sam —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers below and next steps:

1) SSO: We'll use Okta (SAML2). I'll attach the metadata and a simple presign diagram. We can also create a service account if you need API uploads; prefer to use role-based uploads through the portal.

2) Export: We'll upload a CAIQ v4 export and include a separate SIG-derived worksheet for any narrative answers that don't map cleanly. That keeps the portal CAIQ-first but gives you the context.

Next steps I propose:
- I will share a draft CAIQ/response workbook by EOD. (attachment: redwood_SIG-draft-responses.xlsx)
- Naomi will request temporary "evidence uploader" access in Vendr and share the portal invite.
- Karthik will join the evidence review to confirm where we have SOC 2 artifacts versus portal proofs.

Could you confirm Wed 06/25 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 06/26 09:00-09:30 PT for the review?

Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_SIG-draft-responses.xlsx, sso-presign-diagram.png

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novumcloud.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, security@novumcloud.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: portal access + SIG/CAIQ scope

Thanks Marcus — that plan works. Wed 06/25 10:00 PT is good; invite sent (calendar link in invite). A couple of clarifying notes from our portal intake team: 

- The portal requires an evidence manifest for any SOC 2 items pointing to S3 locations or attachments. If you prefer, you can provide a short manifest file (csv) that maps SIG question IDs to artifact filenames.
- We recommend marking any items that are covered by our SOC 2+ security supplement as "Authority: SOC2" so reviewers can fast-track them.

I'll provision a temp uploader role for the "marcus_lin@redwood.com" identity and include the Okta audience we provisioned. Expect the Vendr invite to appear shortly.

Sam

Perfect — thank you for provisioning the uploader role. A couple of housekeeping items we covered on our side after prepping the workbook: 

- Naomi: please confirm the portal invite and uploader TTL (temporary access window).
- Karthik: we'll annotate each SIG row with an "authority" column (SOC2 / Policy / Design Doc) and include presigned S3 links for artifacts that can't live in the portal UI. The manifest will be uploaded as manifest_v1.csv.

Sam — for the Wed review I'd like to walk through: 1) the CAIQ mapping decisions where we used SOC 2 as authority; 2) the manifest format for presigned links; 3) an action list for any missing artifacts (owner and due date).

See you on Wed.

— Marcus
